scope: Offline synthetic adapter-proof corpus. No native score authority or adapter enabled.

fixed_contracts.contract: An exact transport replay must retain identical owner, generation, combo, canonical occurrence, ownership/identity/semantics attestations, meaning and action attribution.
fixed_contracts.before: Payload-only duplicate shortcut ignored contradictory proof and retained credited authority.
fixed_contracts.after: Contradiction taints the boundary and invalidates unconfirmed monetary credit.

fixed_contracts.contract: Every admitted observation, including exact duplicates, advances the stream context clock.
fixed_contracts.before: A later duplicate did not prevent a subsequent health snapshot from moving backward in time.
fixed_contracts.after: Clock rollback after a duplicate is stale and closes monetary authority.

fixed_contracts.contract: A transport duplicate cannot restore a tainted stream's admission classification.
fixed_contracts.before: Replay shortcut could report duplicate after a health gap, though settlement remained invalidated.
fixed_contracts.after: Replay remains incomplete until an independently delimited new baseline.

preserved_existing_contracts: Owner, generation, combo and health loss discard monetary authority without resetting live physical balance or fatigue.
Equal points do not establish identity; conflicting occurrence reuse and two occurrences claiming one action fail closed.
Verified action slots may arrive out of action order, but transport serial gaps, old timestamps and incomplete coverage cannot settle.
Only independently attested integer raw action awards are added. Native aggregates and unknown multiplier semantics are not inferred or counted twice.
Manual, grind, exit and revert transitions preserve existing model continuity; credited points neither manufacture actions nor extend grace.
Clean/bail terminal conflicts cannot create a second receipt. An already published bank or loss remains immutable until drained.
Native end plus model expiry requires fresh complete terminal health; absence of points is not an authoritative zero bank.
A new independently delimited owner/combo namespace can reuse occurrence values; old-context evidence cannot cross it.
native_questions_remaining: Independent local payload-owner and observer-generation attribution for every admitted award/end event.
Canonical native occurrence identity shared across duplicate listeners and its independently verified mapping to an observed action slot.
Whether each candidate native payload is raw action value or includes native multiplier/landing factors.
Native clean/bail meaning and completeness through the later model link-window terminal.
native_evidence_required: An owner-bound, canonically identified action/end stream with independently established value semantics and complete health across its terminal. Existing unowned captures remain unverified; capture serial, HUD text, timestamp coincidence or equal values cannot substitute.
